text: As I move from the quiet, glass-walled entry into the vibrant exhibit, I feel a transformative shift. The initial emptiness makes me conscious of my presence and anticipation stirs within me. Now, surrounded by colors and ideas about innovation and technology, I feel energized, my thoughts spinning with the possibilities of what development means—not just for humanity, but for me in this moment of encounter. The world opens, and I am both a spectator and a participant, aware that curiosity is its own form of creation.
